# This repository was extracted from a private research monorepo, and the
# guarantee that lab-only material never reaches it used to come from the
# generator that assembled it. That generator is retired — the crate is now
# developed here directly — so the guarantee lives here instead, as a check
# rather than a memory.
#
# Adding an entry is a PUBLICATION decision: this repository is public and
# permanent. Anything added here is visible forever, so the line you add to
# this file is the record of having decided that on purpose.
